item.title: Tears and defiance as Lebanese family bury child, 11, killed in Israeli strike
item.summary: Jawad Younes and his uncle Ragheb were laid to rest on Saturday after their family compound was hit a day earlier.

item.title: Latin Patriarch will have access to Jerusalem holy site after police stopped entry
item.summary: The Israeli PM said Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa had been asked not to enter the church out of concern for his safety.

item.title: Three arrested in Paris after attempted bomb attack outside Bank of America
item.summary: France's anti-terrorism prosecutor's office said it had immediately taken over the investigation.

item.title: Myanmar junta chief Min Aung Hlaing nominated as president
item.summary: The military leader, who has been sanctioned by Western countries, is now certain to get the job.

item.title: Fugitive Dezi Freeman shot dead by Australian police after seven months in hiding
item.summary: Freeman has been wanted since the fatal shooting of two police officers in Porepunkah in August.

item.title: Three killed as unfinished building collapses on church service in Ghana
item.summary: Locals say the structure, in a school complex, was in use despite lying unfinished for a number of years.

item.title: Fuel tax halved and free public transport offered as war pushes up prices in Australia
item.summary: Victoria and Tasmania are incentivising commuters not to drive in a bid to ease cost pressures.

item.title: Shops and restaurants in Egypt told to close early as energy crisis deepens
item.summary: Retail and dining premises will have to shut by 21:00 each night for the next month to conserve power.

item.title: Partial government shutdown becomes the longest in US history
item.summary: The 44-day funding lapse for the Department of Homeland Security has led to travel chaos at US airports.

item.title: Thieves steal Renoir, Cézanne and Matisse paintings in three-minute Italian heist
item.summary: The paintings were taken from a museum in Parma by four masked men in the middle of the night, police say.
